claim_statement: Character 3-5gram BM25 maintains resilience over whole words and dense bi-encoders under OCR degradation (+0.1065 Apple Clean, +0.1276 degraded blur, +0.1048 clean Tesseract; all p_Holm < 1e-4)
auditor_remarks: Empirically verified on SROIE N=626 across 3 OCR engines with 100,000 sign-flip permutations.

claim_statement: On answerable factual questions, CPU lexical retrieval (Char BM25 0.9328 Real-OCR, 0.9471 Clean GT) outperforms native ColQwen2 (0.8595; diff +0.0733, p = 0.0011) at 0.87 ms vs 249.21 ms
subsystem: CPU Lexical vs GPU Late Interaction
auditor_remarks: Verified on SROIE N=306 answerable queries. ColQwen2 MaxSim scores independently audited.

claim_statement: Evaluating distractor pool scaling across 600x expansion (813 to 500,000 items) demonstrates verbatim advantage consistently persists across scales (+0.1059 to +0.1691 at 500K, z = 8.12, p < 1e-15)
auditor_remarks: Char BM25 reaches 0.8945 vs Word BM25 0.7254 at 500K items.

claim_statement: Analyzing query formulation dynamics across multi-generator dose-response suite (N=1,930, comprising 1,224 GPT-4o-mini, 400 human-authored, and 306 Qwen2.5-7B queries)
auditor_remarks: Earlier manuscript 1,730 draft corrected to 1,930 total query evaluations.

claim_statement: Under authentic human formulation where entity anchors persist, character and word BM25 perform comparably across all overlap levels (MRRs 0.555-0.577)
auditor_remarks: Word and Char BM25 within 0.027 MRR across 20%-100% overlap bins (all p > 0.25).

claim_statement: Native visual retrieval excels on DocVQA (MRR 0.6450 vs proxies <= 0.3507, noting disclosed ViDoRe pretraining overlap) and photographic search (SigLIP MRR 0.6071 vs caption proxies <= 0.4420)
auditor_remarks: ViDoRe training mixture overlap properly disclosed in Section IV and Section VI.

claim_statement: Two-stage cascade (K1=50 Word BM25 -> ColQwen2) retains 97.2% of visual MRR (0.4822 vs 0.4962) with an analytically modeled 15.4x latency reduction (16.20 ms vs 249.21 ms)
auditor_remarks: Manuscript correctly states modeled latency estimate based on component hardware measurements.

claim_statement: Automated end-to-end QA audit (N=150) shows retrieval MRR bounds generation accuracy (ANLS 0.3990 ColQwen2 vs 0.3246 Char BM25); dual-reviewer audit across N=110 personal retrieval answers confirms kappa = 0.9031
auditor_remarks: Strictly decoupled: QA is automated ANLS/EM (N=150); Human review is photo & relational retrieval (N=110, kappa = 0.9031).

claim_statement: Cross-encoder MiniLM reranker yields statistically significant lift over Word BM25 on clean Real-OCR (p_Holm = 0.0450 <= 0.05)
auditor_remarks: Corrected sorting bug in original table which previously misordered it as non-significant (p=0.054).

claim_statement: LLM Bridge vs Sparse BM25 on initial N=50 slice does not achieve statistical significance after Holm-Bonferroni correction (p_raw = 0.0215, p_Holm = 0.1075 > 0.05)
auditor_remarks: Fixed multiplier bug (multiplied by 5 instead of 2). Correctly labeled non-significant.

claim_statement: Extractive PRF and generative LLM bridge achieve identical Hit@10 = 0.8200 on pooled N=100 benchmark (TOST equivalence at Delta = +-0.05, p_TOST = 0.0073 < 0.01)
auditor_remarks: Parametric Student t TOST strictly rejects non-equivalence at alpha=0.01. Eliminates 4,736 ms LLM latency.

claim_statement: Marginal split conformal calibration controls expected miss risk at 0.0491 <= 0.05 with 78.4% escalation rate; RCPS (delta=0.10) achieves 82.0% empirical split coverage, consistent with finite-sample binomial variance on N=1,377 test sets
auditor_remarks: Mathematical proof confirms binomial sampling standard error (sigma = 0.00546) predicts 82% empirical satisfaction.

claim_statement: Conformal gating fails on semantic subgroups: entity-rewrite miss risk inflates to 0.0529 - 0.0627 (> 0.05), justifying simpler fixed-margin cascades in production
auditor_remarks: Disclosed negative result highlighting that marginal calibration does not provide conditional safety under semantic shifts.

claim_statement: Bipartite line-aligned Levenshtein matching on clean SROIE yields CER = 0.1387 and WER = 0.2165 (a 51.3% reduction from concatenated metrics), isolating optical noise from 2D reading-order permutations
auditor_remarks: Independently audited. Concat CER 0.2848 drops to line-aligned CER 0.1387 on Apple Vision.
